title: Joseph March — Family & Biography

# Joseph March (1797–1883)

**Born:** 1797 in Aylsham, Norfolk, England
**Baptised:** 1 Jun 1797 at St Michael, Aylsham
**Died:** 30 Oct 1883 in Prospect, South Australia
**Buried:** North Road Cemetery, Nailsworth, South Australia

## Family

| Relation | Name |
|----------|------|
| **Father** | [[Joseph March (1767–1831)]] |
| **Mother** | [[Sarah Jacobs (~1763–1811)]] |
| **Spouse** | [[Sophia Webster]] (married 31 Oct 1825, Aylsham) |
| **Children** | [[Sophia March (1829–1901)]] (m. Baker), Hannah March (m. Sloman), Joseph March, William March ×2, Susanna March, Charles March, Samuel March, Alfred March, John Henry March |

## Life

Joseph was born in Aylsham, Norfolk in 1797 and worked as an agricultural labourer according to the 1841 England & Wales census.

He married Sophia Webster at St Michael's Church, Aylsham on 31 October 1825.

The family emigrated to the Colony of South Australia aboard the ship *Canton*, arriving 31 July 1846 with his wife and seven children.

He died on 30 October 1883 in Prospect, Adelaide and is buried at North Road Cemetery, Nailsworth.
